protocol.ground_truth_isolation: The API inference manifest contained no per-image species labels. Ground truth was read only after both models completed all requested predictions.
protocol.image_preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB conversion, longest side capped at 1536px, JPEG quality 90, metadata removed

summary.confidence_note: VLM confidence is a self-reported score requested in the response schema. It is not a normalized model probability; the five scores need not sum to one.
